title: Area Lead, Data Center Security Operations (NORAM - North East)
description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As Anthropic's Data Center Security Operations Lead , you will own day-to-day physical security operations across our data center campuses in the area, including sites run with operating partners. You will be the person on the ground: the one who knows each site, its guard force, its local responders and what is actually happening on the floor. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll be on-site most weeks and get things done through people and companies you don't manage: site operators, guard vendors, construction and infrastructure partners, and your colleagues on the Data Center Security Engineering team. You will have the authority to make operational calls at your sites, and you'll work with the team's systems and delivery roles to take over each new site as it moves into operation. The function is still in build mode. The work is ambiguous and changes as strategy changes. We need someone who can scope a loosely defined problem, carry it through to a result without waiting for a mature playbook, and treat security as an enabler of business outcomes. Key responsibilities Own the physical security operations program across our North East campuses, from a site's move into operations through steady state Act as first call for site issues, including after hours, leading incident response and investigations and writing up what happened and what changes Own guard force and vendor performance: post coverage, attrition, SLA grading, and the conversations that follow Make time-sensitive operational and escalation decisions at your sites Adapt company-wide standards into post orders, patrol standards, and badging and visitor procedures, keeping them consistent across sites and flagging where a standard doesn't fit Partner with build, delivery and engineering teams on design and activation so that each turnover to operations is clean Build and keep local relationships with law enforcement, emergency services, landlords and site operators Lead cross-functional security work and represent your sites in infrastructure, compute and real estate decisions Minimum qualifications Experience running physical security operations across multiple sites in data centers, critical infrastructure or comparable high-security facilities Experience managing a guard or integrator vendor against an SLA, using evidence and following through on missed performance Experience leading physical security incident response, including after hours, and writing post-incident reports Ability to turn standards into written site procedures and post orders that get adopted and followed Ability to drive decisions with operators, vendors and internal partners without formal authority Based near Buffalo or Rochester, or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site most weeks Availability for after-hours on-call Location: New York, based near Buffalo or Rochester Preferred qualifications Experience at a hyperscaler or major colocation operator Experience taking a site from construction into live operations, including receiving the turnover Experience in both owned data centers and colocation or partner-operated space, with an understanding of how the operator and tenant relationship changes controls, vendors and incident response A track record of calibrating security to business reality, including explaining when you chose not to apply a control A track record of re-scoping work without losing momentum when design or strategy shifts CPP (Certified Protection Professional) or PSP (Physical Security Professional) certification Experience building working relationships with law enforcement and emergency services, ideally in New York Experience in a regulated environment, such as financial services or government Experience supporting an external audit or customer security review of data center physical controls The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $290,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
